newsitem.title: UK: Cookson unit wins 10 mln stg contracts.
newsitem.headline: Cookson unit wins 10 mln stg contracts.

text.p: British industrial materials group Cookson Group Plc said on Monday that its fibre optic division FOCAS had been awarded three contracts with combined sales of around 10 million stg.
Cookson said it got the first phase of a 1,300 km optical groundwire project contract from the Municipal Electric Authority of Georgia and its estimated worth is 4.3 million stg.
The division would create a 400 km OPGW project in Venezuela. The value of which would be around 4.3 million stg. The project would connect Yaracuy, El Tablazo and Cuartricentenario.
Cookson said a further contract was expected in Venezuela after the completion of the first phase of this contract.
FOCAS would also install a 230 km OPGW system in China. The digital transmission and communications system would be worth over 1.4 million stg.
